# Local QR generator

`qrcode.js`: qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT license.
Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/1.4.4
The original copyright/license notice is retained in the file. One ES-module export was appended. All QR generation runs locally; there are no network requests.
